oneLine: J B Ecotex submits draft IPO documents to SEBI targeting 400 crore.

sources.title: J B Ecotex Submits Draft IPO Documents To Sebi, Targets ₹400 Crore From Fresh Issue Of Shares

synopsis: Surat-based PET recycler J B Ecotex Ltd has filed draft papers with SEBI for an initial public offering consisting of a fresh issue of shares worth up to ₹400 crore and an offer for sale of up to 1.29 crore equity shares by promoters. The company may also raise up to ₹80 crore via a pre-IPO placement, which would reduce the fresh issue size. J B Ecotex plans to utilize ₹320 crore of the fresh issue proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings held by the company and its subsidiary, with the remainder allocated for general corporate purposes. Proceeds from the promoter OFS will go to the selling shareholders. Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors and JM Financial are acting as the book-running lead managers for the proposed listing on the BSE and NSE.
